summary: Titan Mining's wholly owned subsidiary Empire State Mines and the U.S. Department of the Army executed a non-binding term sheet for an Enhanced Use Lease covering roughly 97 acres at Anniston Army Depot, Alabama, where ESM would develop, finance, build, own and operate a commercial graphite processing facility. Terms include an initial 50-year lease plus two 25-year renewals (up to 100 years), and an Army right of first offer capped at 10% of annual PMG/CSPG output, exempting committed offtake. Diligence continues at Pine Bluff Arsenal and Fort Drum. This is an ordinary commercial/real-property framework, not a special situation; watch definitive EUL timing, financing, and qualification milestones.
